general.title: Robert Pattinson Is New James Bond in Amazon’s Reboot
general.summary: Batman star Robert Pattinson is the latest actor to take on the role of superspy James Bond as Amazon’s MGM Studios looks to reboot the franchise. Ed Ludlow has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: ETF Launches Blow Past IPOs: Slavin
general.summary: Ben Slavin, managing director, global head of ETFs at BNY, joins Isabelle Lee and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss how ETF launches have surpassed IPOs and his firms efforts in tokenization. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Tradeweb Is Rolling Out AI Assistant for US Treasury Traders
general.summary: Tradeweb Markets Inc. is launching an AI-powered assistant for government bond traders, as electronic-trading venues race to make artificial intelligence a central feature of their platforms.

general.title: Citigroup Pulls $400 Million Loan for IT Provider UST Global
general.summary: A group of banks led by Citigroup Inc. has pulled a debt deal for UST Global Inc. from the syndicated loan market after lenders did not attract enough demand from investors.

general.title: AI and 24-Hour Trading Test Rules Governing Currency Markets
general.summary: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence and round-the-clock trading is raising questions about whether rules governing the $9.5 trillion foreign-exchange market can keep pace with technological change.

general.title: Big Test Ahead For Equity Appetite: Nadig
general.summary: Dave Nadig, president & director of Research at ETF.com, joins Isabelle Lee and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss private markets and the upcoming IPO for Anthropic. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Fed’s Hammack Prefers Small Hikes, Sees Risk of Bigger Moves
general.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said she favors small and steady increases in interest rates, but the central bank may need to consider larger moves if inflation pressure worsens.

general.title: Skilled Immigration Lowers Pay for College-Educated US Workers, Study Finds
general.summary: Skilled immigration leads to lower wages for college-educated US workers, particularly in scientific fields, according to a paper by a Harvard University economist who served on President Donald Trump’s Council of Economic Advisers.

general.title: Altimeter's Brad Gerstner aims to invest $5 billion in Anthropic IPO
general.summary: Gerstner told CNBC that he's looking to put five time as much money into Anthropic as he's ever put into a prior IPO.

general.title: Hadrian Targets Critical Bottleneck in US Shipbuilding
general.summary: Defense manufacturer Hadrian is investing $300 million to acquire and modernize a historic Pennsylvania foundry that produces critical components for US Navy ships and submarines. CEO Chris Power discusses why domestic casting capacity has become a major bottleneck for America’s defense industrial base and how AI and advanced manufacturing could boost production. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Apple to Let Users Face-Unlock iPhone Duo, Addressing Key Drawback
general.summary: Apple Inc. added the ability for iPhone Duo owners to unlock the device using facial recognition, addressing a key drawback of the company’s first foldable smartphone.
